snippet.title: Albor - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
The dawn of a new adventure is here. Welcome to ALBOR. 🌅

⚔️ WISHLIST ALBOR ON STEAM NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4482950/Albor/

ALBOR is a roguelike dungeon crawler with turn-based combat, deeply inspired by the classic TTRPG dungeon-crawling experience. Explore an unforgiving tower, fight with strategic precision, and design unique parties on every run!

⚔️ Key Features:

Dynamic Party Building: Combine 8 distinct classes and 8 races. No two runs are the same as your heroes evolve differently every time.

Strategic Combat: Exploit elemental affinities, master powerful status effects, and find the perfect skill synergies to secure victory.

The "DUEL" Mechanic: Go head-to-head against enemy skills. The winner executes their action, while the loser loses their turn. Every +1 to your Duel Roll matters to protect your party!

d20 Tower Events: Face dilemmas, traps, and other adventurers using a classic d20 roll system influenced by your party's unique attributes.

Join the Lion Brotherhood community so you don't miss any development updates:
🐦 Twitter: https://x.com/LionBrotherhood
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lionbrotherhood/
🌐 Official Website: https://lionbrotherhood.com.ar

Support the development of ALBOR by leaving a Like, Subscribing, and letting us know what you think of this first look in the comments!
